changes: Synced proofbound tracked code, config, docs, and package metadata to the Orchestrate 0.3.63 baseline while keeping legacy evidence and local experiment paths out of the publishable repository state.
usage: Run the CLI from proofbound with node bin/lattice.js or the installed lattice command; node bin/lattice.js --version now reports Lattice CLI 0.3.63 and package metadata is aligned at 0.3.63.
expectedOutcome: Proofbound is the canonical clean checkout at the same tracked Lattice CLI/runtime baseline as Orchestrate 0.3.63, without importing retired-root prompts, story evidence, fixtures, or local experiments.
actualTranscript: node bin/lattice.js --version -> Lattice CLI 0.3.63; npm --prefix packages/main run build passed; npm --prefix packages/utils run build passed; node bin/lattice.js validate --story=B-c76c --json passed 25/25 configured commands and 12/12 verification intents; node bin/lattice.js done_required_validate --storyId=B-c76c passed packages/main build and root full test suite; delivery_check_set accepted the delivery evidence.
outcomeDiff: No functional version mismatch remains for the tracked proofbound baseline. The only noted process nuance was story-local delivery evidence needing explicit scope acknowledgement because the scope classifier did not automatically classify those evidence JSON files.
limitations: This story does not normalize the preserved B-3523/B-fbb6 migrated branch history, remove non-active Orchestrate lab or temporary worktrees, or implement the retired-root/canonical-root guard; B-bcd4 covers the guard next.
pitfalls: Do not copy Orchestrate package-lock metadata blindly because its root lock version was stale; proofbound regenerated lock metadata to 0.3.63 and intentionally excluded docs/story, tests/fixtures, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, local evidence, and experiments.
